classification_policy.production_bypass: direct non-canonical provider, private YM-data import, vendor URL, direct HTTP/provider fallback, or direct WorkBuddy/Tencent/TDX/MCP in a production path
classification_policy.production_reference: provider/UI label or generic transport reference without a bounded provider call
classification_policy.dependency_metadata: dependency or skill/package manifest; never a runtime consumer finding
classification_policy.approved_compatibility: known compatibility or internal reader boundary retained for inventory and later migration review
classification_policy.approved_internal_transport: same-application read transport, such as an internal GET API; host/port alone never approves writes
classification_policy.production_write_transport: POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE or equivalent write-shaped transport; fail closed and never auto-approved
classification_policy.ambiguous: same-file URL/transport association cannot prove vendor identity; preserve for human review and fail closed
classification_policy.agent_tooling_channels: SKILL.md and executable scripts under .agents/skills, .claude/skills, and .workbuddy/skills; direct provider clients remain explicit-only and generic A-share production must use canonical query
classification_policy.test_fixture_archive_generated: scanned and reported separately; path class does not suppress production findings elsewhere
classification_policy.unknown: fail closed for unreadable production files, missing roots, or external production symlinks
